title: 练习1 卡方
author: 原资料贡献者, 题库整理者

question.content: A researcher aims to investigate whether smoking status is associated with the presence of lung disease in adults. A sample of 200 individuals is classified according to their smoking status and lung disease status as shown below. (alpha = 0.05, round all intermediate and final calculations to two decimal places)
Please fill in the expected frequencies below:
Please perform the Chi-square test and draw a conclusion.

answer.content:
H0: 吸烟状态与肺病状态独立; H1: 二者有关联
期望频数为 [[30.00,70.00],[30.00,70.00]], 各格E=行和×列和/200, df=1
按题意每项先保留两位: χ²=3.33+1.43+3.33+1.43=9.52. 使用未舍入中间值为9.52381, p≈0.002028
临界值3.84, 在α=0.05下拒绝H0, 吸烟状态与肺病存在统计关联. 样本患病比例为40%和20%, 此关联检验本身不证明因果

question.content:
A public-health researcher wants to determine whether the ABO blood-group distribution in a community matches a specified reference distribution.

The researcher randomly selects 200 unrelated adults from a large community and records each participant’s blood group once. Assume that the observations are independent.
At a significance level of 0.05, is there evidence that the community’s blood-group distribution differs from the reference distribution?
